decision: Extract agenda-core crate from agenda-gpui: types (Todo/Project/Tag), date helpers, smart-list filters, quick-entry parse, recurrence, Engine object mapping; all clock reads behind LocalDay param
why: Android needs the same date/list/parse rules without GPUI or ureq; single source avoids drift
evidence: cargo test -p agenda-core: 17 passed; cargo check --workspace --all-targets: ok; cargo fmt --check: ok; cargo clippy -p agenda-core -- -D warnings: ok; check-source-size: ok

decision: Inventory of desktop features recorded for Android parity
why: Android scope must match real desktop features, not assumptions
evidence: docs/feature-inventory.md lists every route, task field, quick-entry syntax, sort/group, statistics, theme from file:line

decision: No undo or reminder scheduler exists on desktop
why: Discovered during inventory; Android parity target excludes them
evidence: rg for undo/notification finds only data fields (reminder_date), no firing code

decision: engine-mobile crate: synchronous UniFFI methods (not async exports); Kotlin wraps calls in Dispatchers.IO and ChangeListener in callbackFlow
why: UniFFI 0.29 async needs a Rust async runtime contract; sync fns are the simplest correct surface and all blocking happens on the ark worker thread anyway
evidence: src/lib.rs compiles; generated Kotlin shows plain fun signatures (engine_mobile.kt)

decision: subscribe takes Box<dyn ChangeListener>; ChangeSubscription object owns a pump thread stopped on drop
why: UniFFI 0.29 callback interfaces only satisfy FfiConverterArc for Box<dyn T>, not Arc<dyn T>; pump thread must be stoppable independently of engine close
evidence: compile error E0277 forced Box; pump stop via tokio::sync::watch + select! in the pump loop

decision: call(op, params_json) returns the full {"ok","data","error"} JSON string; EngineError only for closed/unavailable/bad-json
why: Same wire shape as desktop /v1/rpc so Kotlin shares response handling with desktop clients
evidence: ark_host.rs request() wraps ArkService::call the same way; tests/roundtrip.rs asserts through it

decision: device_id persisted at <data_dir>/mundus-device-id.txt, generated as 16 hex of a uuid v4
why: Mirrors desktop resolve_device_id (runtime/src/sync.rs) so sync identity survives reinstalls of the lib; no desktop path discovery on Android
evidence: lib.rs resolve_device_id; filename identical to desktop

decision: No cfg-gating needed in ark-core for Android: iroh 1.2, if-addrs 0.13, hostname 0.4, tokio signal all compile for aarch64/x86_64-linux-android
why: Unit brief anticipated gates; the whole dep tree built clean
evidence: cargo ndk -t arm64-v8a -t x86_64 build -p engine-mobile --release: finished ok; libengine_mobile.so 28M per ABI

decision: com.kosmos.task@1.1.0 needs no registration step: canonical definitions install at db open (prepare_registry_for_objects)
why: Canonical types are compiled into ark-core and seeded on open_db; upsert_object enforces canonical_version_required
evidence: cargo test -p engine-mobile: task_roundtrip_survives_reopen ok (upsert with typeVersion 1.1.0, date-format scheduledAt, list, object_upserted event, reopen persists)

decision: uniffi pinned at "0.29" (resolved 0.29.5), library mode via setup_scaffolding!, bindgen bin behind cli feature
why: Spec says 0.28+/0.29; cli feature keeps clap/goblin out of the Android cdylib build
evidence: cargo run -p engine-mobile --features cli --bin uniffi-bindgen -- generate --library target/debug/libengine_mobile.so --language kotlin: produced /tmp/engine-mobile-bindings/com/mundus/engine/engine_mobile.kt (2123 lines)

decision: deny.toml gained skip for toml (0.5 via uniffi_macros vs 1.1 via embed-resource)
why: New duplicate is unavoidable until uniffi bumps its toml dep
